label: <DEL> step when the first original token is h/0/f (plus weak t=0 w)
explanation: 86% of activation mass is at the delimiter step (recall of original token 0), and it is strongly gated by which token must be output first: out_tok h (12x lift), 0 (10x), f (6x), weaker 1/y. All top activations are <DEL> steps in sequences starting with h or 0. Only about half of delimiter steps with h/0/f first exceed threshold, so precision is incomplete. Longer L and to_go raise the rate somewhat, but restricting to L>=7 did not improve the fit. A second, small, separate component: input w at t=0 always fires, but very weakly (~0.03 of max, ~4% of mass). Low-level spillover at recall_idx 1 (the step after <DEL>, e.g. when orig(1) is h). It is essentially silent in the later copy phase and on mid-sequence original tokens.
